description: This file defines the CachePool class for managing in-memory and Redis-based caches for LLM, Embeddings, and SSO tokens, including methods for adding, retrieving, and deleting cache entries, as well as initializing Redis connections based on environment variables.

classes.name: CachePool
classes.description: Manages various cache pools including in-memory and Redis-backed caches for LLM, Embeddings, MCP, and SSO tokens.

methods.name: addSSOTokenCache
methods.description: Adds an SSO token to the cache, using Redis if in queue mode, otherwise in-memory.

methods.name: getSSOTokenCache
methods.description: Retrieves an SSO token from the cache, using Redis if in queue mode, otherwise in-memory.

methods.name: deleteSSOTokenCache
methods.description: Deletes an SSO token from the cache, using Redis if in queue mode, otherwise in-memory.

methods.name: addLLMCache
methods.description: Adds an LLM cache entry, serialized and stored in Redis if in queue mode, otherwise in-memory.

methods.name: addEmbeddingCache
methods.description: Adds an Embedding cache entry, serialized and stored in Redis if in queue mode, otherwise in-memory.

methods.name: addMCPCache
methods.description: Adds an MCP cache entry in-memory if not in queue mode.

methods.name: getMCPCache
methods.description: Retrieves an MCP cache entry from memory if not in queue mode.

methods.name: getLLMCache
methods.description: Retrieves an LLM cache entry, deserializing from Redis if in queue mode, otherwise from memory.

methods.name: getEmbeddingCache
methods.description: Retrieves an Embedding cache entry, deserializing from Redis if in queue mode, otherwise from memory.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the Redis connection if it exists.
